name: LeaseReturnRemarketingDesk
tagline: From contract end to sale: collections, inspection, recharges, grounding decisions and remarketing in one app.
description: A complete end-of-contract app for lessors and dealer groups: maturing contracts and collections, the inspection queue with SLA, excess-mileage and damage recharges with invoice/dispute/waive tracking, a grounding desk that compares retail, auction, lessee purchase and retain against the contract residual, remarketing channels with days-listed aging, and sale outcomes. Works instantly with sample data in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Allowed status moves with required fields per status
Excess mileage × agreement rate + damage recharge with waive threshold
Net proceeds per option (retail, auction, lessee purchase, retain) vs residual with recommendation and override reason
Retail eligibility by condition grade and mileage
Remarketing channels with days-listed aging, withdraw and mark sold
Sale outcomes: price vs ask, vs residual, days to sell
Search, sort, group, filters, bulk book/decide/raise recharges, CSV export, undo
Phone bottom bar and card layouts
Power Fx outputs and events (OnSelect, OnChange, OnCreate, OnSave, OnAction, OnStatusChange)
